text:
12 Time limits.

(1) This section has effect for the purpose of determining the relevant period for sections
3, 5, 6 [F35, 6B, 6C and 7A(5)] .

(2) Subject to subsection (3), the relevant period is a period beginning and ending with
such days as the Secretary of State prescribes by regulations for the purposes of the
section concerned.

(3) The regulations may do one or more of the following—
(a) provide that the relevant period for any section shall if the court so orders be
extended (or further extended) by so many days as the court specifies;
(b) provide that the court may only make such an order if an application is made
by a prescribed person and if any other prescribed conditions are fulfilled;
(c) provide that an application may only be made if prescribed conditions are
fulfilled;
(d) provide that the number of days by which a period may be extended shall be
entirely at the court’s discretion;
